predecessors.name: Sultanate of Rum
predecessors.text: Ankara and its surroundings, which the Ahis took in semi-independence 'towards the end of the century (about 1290)' under Mongol suzerainty

successors.name: Ottoman Empire
successors.text: Ankara, annexed briefly by Orhan in 1354 and finally in 1362 when 'Murad I ended the political power of Ahis'

ledger.x: c. 1290: the Ahis of Ankara declare semi-independence. 'Ahis in Ankara also saw their chance to declare their semi-independence under Mongol suzerainty' 'towards the end of the century (about 1290)'. The page gives the city, not a boundary, and the Ilkhanid suzerainty is the Ilkhanate's to record.
1354: Orhan annexes Ankara for a time.
1362: Murad I ends the Ahis' political power.
1362: the Ahi state of Ankara ends.

wars.name: Ottoman takeover of Ankara from the Ahis
wars.outcome: Orhan briefly annexes Ankara in 1354; after his death the Ahis 'tried to restore their independence' and in 1362 Murad I ended their political power.

certainty.note: The Ahi territory is a city and its surroundings; no page gives a boundary, so the whole life is soft.
